title: Quietly Rich Polish Rye Bread Toast
description: A rich and springy solo-dinner Polish dish featuring rye bread, perfect for a quiet evening meal. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and mortar-pestle-pounded goodness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar, pound the caraway seeds and coriander seeds until coarsely ground.
Add the salt and black pepper to the mortar and mix well.
Brush the rye bread slices with olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle the ground seed mixture evenly over the bread slices.
Drizzle the apple cider vinegar over the bread.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the bread from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh dill.
Serve the toast warm and enjoy.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
